rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Microsoft OneNote integration that enables AI agents to read and create notebooks, sections, and pages through the Microsoft Graph API. Uses Azure AD Device Code Flow for authentication with automatic token caching, making it accessible for desktop applications without requiring complex OAuth redirects. Provides tools for listing notebooks, sections, and pages, reading page content, and creating new OneNote structures with proper HTML formatting.
